_help: ONE FILE FOR ALL SITE CONTENT. Edit values, save, publish. Do not edit index.html.
business  → name, WhatsApp number (one place), pre-filled messages, social links, copyright.
branches  → the footer branch line, the branch list in the popover, contact page text.
homepage  → hero text, button labels, badge labels (icons stay in code), section heading.
pages     → About, Manufacturing, Contact, Appointment, Categories page text and images.
sizes     → pixel sizes for hero text, category cards, product cards, header/footer height.
catalog   → categories → subCategories → types, filters, placeholder settings.
products  → one object per product. Add an object to add a product, delete it to remove it.
Image fields accept any hosted URL: upload in the CRM, copy the link, paste it here.

about.title: Building homes with trust.
about.lead: A regional showroom business for furniture, electronics and everyday home goods.
paragraphs: Sri Maruthi Enterprises helps families furnish rooms that feel settled — not staged. From cots and sofas to appliances that earn their place on the counter, the work is to choose well and explain clearly.
Three branches across two locations keep the showroom close: Rajampet (2) · Railway Koduru (1).

manufacturing.title: Craftsmanship you can trust.
manufacturing.lead: Furniture made with measured joins, honest timber and a finish that lasts.

steps.title: Select
steps.text: Timber and materials chosen for the room they will live in.

steps.text: Workshop cutting, joining and finishing under a single eye.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: Edges, hardware and sit-test before anything reaches the floor.

steps.title: Place
steps.text: Delivered and set so the piece belongs in the home.
